evidence.Default/Up: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 1, leader from the top of the control pad: Aims arrows upwards. (climbs ladders)
evidence.Default/Left/Right: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 2, leader to the side of the control pad: Moves Pit left and right.
evidence.Default/Down: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 3, leader from the bottom of the control pad: Makes Pit squat and jump down from floors.
evidence.Default/A: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 7, leader to the A button: Makes Pit jump.
evidence.Default/B: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 6, leader to the B button: Attacks the enemy.
evidence.Default/Select: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 4, box printed under SELECT with no leader line drawn: Select weapons.
evidence.Default/Start: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 5, box printed under START with no leader line drawn: Switches to menu display (pause).; pdf8 (printed 13): If you press the START button during the game, the menu display appears.
evidence.Stage 4/Up: pdf7 (printed 12): In stage 4, you can make Pit fly upwards by pressing the top of the control pad.
evidence.Stage 4/Down: pdf7 (printed 12): He flies down again when you press the bottom of the control pad.
evidence.Stage 4/Left/Right: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 2, leader to the side of the control pad: Moves Pit left and right.
evidence.Stage 4/B: pdf7 (printed 12): Pit can attack when you press B button and he raises his shield to defend himself when you release the button.
evidence.Stage 4/Select: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 4, box printed under SELECT with no leader line drawn: Select weapons.
evidence.Stage 4/Start: pdf7 (printed 12): chart item 5, box printed under START with no leader line drawn: Switches to menu display (pause).; pdf8 (printed 13): If you press the START button during the game, the menu display appears.
